text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even while Manhattan Cafe grapples with the issues affecting her body, we manage to pass her health check.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I think over our next steps, Manhattan Cafe tells me she'd like to run in the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, her friend wants her to run alongside Agnes Tachyon in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she does well there, we can work our way up to the G1. I accept Manhattan Cafe's request and we set our sights on the Yayoi Sho.
